title: zöld and sárga: Two More Colours

sections.title: Filling out the colour set
sections.content: A1 already gave you piros, kék, fekete, fehér, and barna. zöld ("green") and sárga ("yellow") round the set out. Colours behave like any other adjective — put them right before the noun, or after van with no linking word for a third-person description.

items.english: What colour does it come in?

items.spanish: A sárga kabát olyan szép, mint a zöld.
items.english: The yellow coat is as nice as the green one.

sections.content: olyan..., mint... is straight from earlier in A2 — it works just as well comparing colours and products as it did comparing people.
